primaryDiagnostic: baseline-1 is the g=4/w0=0.7/maxSynapses=10 cell; reuse that run.

scaffold.featurePlacement: Each bit owns g consecutive indices of a single 192*g-point Fibonacci shell, radius 300. Each cell has permanent reach 600 and nextGrowthAt 1e12.
scaffold.poolPlacement: The unchanged Stage 1 shifted Halton ball, radius 120, own cell radius 60.
scaffold.input: One native SpikeIO port per bit, cells array contains all group IDs; assert every group member fires once at its scheduled tick.
scaffold.projections: Independent seeded projection stream; 8 distinct pool targets per feature cell, native connect() with explicit w0.
scaffold.directSet: Seed-topology count >=ceil(1.02/w0)=2. Primed means exactly one hit. No equality with simulated activation is assumed.
scaffold.cues: ID-ordered disjoint words via unchanged loadVocabulary/selectCues.

training.jitterUnit: One independent seeded integer draw per bit; all g copies share onset. Save draws and feature spike evidence.

stopping.rule: First checkpoint >=30 with both fixed halves of A and B >=0.8 at both 0/60-second delays on contemporaneous cores. C and all other gates are excluded.

training.continuation: Continue primary to 120 regardless of first stopping point. Never replace stopping memory based on later gates.
training.curves: Report contemporary metrics and retrospectively recomputed frozen-stop metrics for every checkpoint. Frozen-reference curves cannot influence the stopping rule.

gates.negative: C rejects, each Jaccard <=0.25, spillover <=25% of smaller core, both delays.
gates.recurrent: Within-core count >=core size and density >=3*pool density for both cores.
gates.retention: Unchanged Stage 1 criterion 8: full A at 60 seconds has Jaccard >=0.8 with A; B also reported.
gates.completion: Each of four fixed halves at both delays >=0.8 and gain >=0.25 vs untrained on the same core.

continued.reference: Frozen stopping cores for specificity, spillover, completion, retention and within-core median.
continued.drift: Jaccard(frozen stopping core, contemporaneous epoch-120 core) >=0.8 for BOTH A/B.
continued.contemporaneous: Report separately; never substitute into gate 11.

controls.matched: Growth/Hebbian/inhibition/shuffled use primary stopping epoch. Untrained zero. Native prune-formed acts on the exact restored stopping circuit.
controls.required: Growth-off and Hebbian-off each fail both 9 and 10; pruning lowers every half below 0.6 from a higher value.
controls.continuedHebbianOff: Native checkpoint restore at stop, then recorded field.setFeatures({hebbian:false}); structure may keep growing until 120.
controls.noPostStopEpochs: If stop=120, continued controls have zero additional epochs; report this limit without extending training.

basin.rule: Prefix of each fixed index order in the sorted eight-bit code; at 4 bits these are exactly the two existing halves. At 8 both orders are the same full cue. No subset search.
basin.probes: Synchronous independent locked clones, both delays, A/B, trained and initial untrained against the same stopping reference; also report epoch-120 contemporary and frozen-reference basins.

audit.observer: Unchanged Stage 1e native potentiation and competition observers. Continued phase imports and merges the original edge lifecycles.
audit.prediction: Aff-only continuous leaky integration of all grouped seed arrivals until threshold 1.02, first crossing per endpoint; actual recurrent delay, inclusive lag 0..0.32 s, since birth. Does not model youth, adaptation, inhibition, rounding or recurrence. Predicted counts never replace observed native events.

decision: GO only when every baseline seed reaches criterion, passes stop gates, gate 11 and all three required control discriminations. All seven cells saved; diagnostics cannot replace primary. Exit 0 GO, 1 scientific NO-GO, 2 execution error.
